purpose: Teach: 平坦/絶え間/見切り/感ずる/働きかける/釘付け/呼ばわり/叱り

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、人生平坦じゃないって悟ったろ
lines.en: Riku — you've figured it out, haven't you? Life isn't flat.
lines.style: Wry, knowing lilt. Playful edge underneath. Leans in like she's sharing a secret joke. Quick tempo, almost sing-song on the observation.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、絶え間ないバイトでお疲れだな、桜
lines.en: You're the one looking exhausted from all those endless shifts, Sakura.
lines.style: Turns it back on her with a half-smile. Light, deflecting but not unkind. Cool distance as armor. Steady eye contact that says he noticed first.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、古い参考書に見切りを付けたな
lines.en: Riku — you finally let go of those old reference books, didn't you.
lines.style: Curious edge, genuinely noticing. Sits with the observation for a beat. Softer now — she's checking in, not needling. Slight upturn at the end, inviting him to confirm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クラスの雰囲気を感ずる力あるな、桜
lines.en: And you've got this way of reading what's happening in the classroom. That's real.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity underneath the cool exterior. Sits forward slightly. Not rehearsed. The praise lands because he doesn't perform it.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、先生に進路を働きかける姿勢だったな
lines.en: You showed up for your teacher about your future, didn't you. Actually pushed.
lines.style: Observant, impressed. Slight lift in the voice like she's noting something worth noting. No sarcasm here — the curiosity is honest.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新作映画に釘付けだったな、桜
lines.en: And here you were, completely lost in that new movie the other night.
lines.style: Wry tease coming back. Lighter tempo. She caught him slipping out of cool-distance mode. Affectionate underneath — she's not really calling him out.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、後輩をダメ呼ばわりすんなよ
lines.en: Hey, don't go calling the underclassmen useless like that.
lines.style: Shift to something firmer. Direct, not mean. The voice that comes out when something actually matters to her. No room for negotiation but no anger either.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生から叱りつけられそうだったな、桜
lines.en: You almost got reamed out by the teacher for that, didn't you.
lines.style: Wry but gentler this time. A warning wrapped in humor. She's watching out. Close to him — the joke is for him alone.
